name: GridPrintExportOptions
description: The options to apply on the Print export.

entries.name: allColumns
entries.description: If `true`, the hidden columns will also be exported.

entries.name: bodyClassName
entries.description: One or more classes passed to the print window.

entries.name: copyStyles
entries.description:
If `false`, all <style> and <link type="stylesheet" /> tags from the <head> will not be copied
to the print window.

entries.name: fields
entries.description:
The columns exported.
This should only be used if you want to restrict the columns exports.

entries.name: fileName
entries.description: The value to be used as the print window title.

entries.name: getRowsToExport
entries.description: Function that returns the list of row ids to export in the order they should be exported.

tags.returns: The list of row ids to export.

entries.name: hideFooter
entries.description: If `true`, the footer is removed for when printing.

entries.name: hideToolbar
entries.description: If `true`, the toolbar is removed for when printing.

entries.name: includeCheckboxes
entries.description: If `true`, the selection checkboxes will be included when printing.

entries.name: pageStyle
entries.description: Provide Print specific styles to the print window.
entries.typeDescription:
string | (() => string)
---
string | 
function pageStyle () => string
